title: Tesla remote operators keep crashing its ‘Robotaxis,’ data shows
summary: Tesla’s latest crash reports to federal regulators add two more “Robotaxi” crashes where a remote operator, not the car’s autonomous system, was driving when it hit something. That brings it to five in the data now. And every remote takeover that has shown up in a Tesla crash report has ended in a collision. more…
